// MiniTP bots (the CTF:X bot engine, MiniTP profile). LOCAL ONLY - never push this folder to a live zone until Travis says so.
// Read at attach when the arena runs the MiniTP event. Same key=value grammar as CTFX/CTFXBots.txt; keys not listed keep the engine defaults.
// Spec: MiniTPBots/MINITP-BOT-META-SPEC.md   Plan: MiniTPBots/PHASE1-PLAN.md
// enabled=0 (the file's resting state) = the CTF:X engine behaves exactly as before; set 1 to run MiniTP bots in the pub arena's MiniTP event.
// MiniTPRoutes.txt / MiniTPPoints.txt in this folder are generated by MiniTPBots/data/gen_routes.py (copy them here after a regenerate).
/* PARSER GUARD: keep a block comment after the last line comment */

enabled=1
autostart=1               // bots spawn when the first human is in the arena (spectators count); all removed after 60 s with nobody
perside=14                // bots per team: 5 / 7 / 10 / 14 (*ctfxbots on N = N per side)
makeRoom=off              // phase 1: no human-takes-a-seat (CTFXRoom benches in the CTF:X ship); fill-to-N comes later

// ---- CTF:X systems that do not apply to MiniTP (phase 1)
command=0                 // the CTF:X commander / intents are keyed to the big map's base ends
tune=0
squads=0                  // SL summons / storms arrive in phase 2
flags=0                   // the nine MiniTP flags are script-owned (InitializeMiniTPEvent); bot flag play is phase 6
chat=1                    // team callouts (CTFXChat.Say: only the humans on the bot's team hear them)
listen=1                  // the bots hear X / S / sum in TEAM chat and summon the human (SL to the enemy base, a Medic home); attack / home calls later
// ---- the macro sounds (Travis's .mc0 files, 11-07): 21 = "XXXXX" / "Summon pls" / "Requesting Summon - To Enemy"; 27 = "Summon Home" / "SSSSS";
//      24 = "At Enemy" / "Attacking Enemy"; 25 = "@Home Safe" / "Defending ... Safe" / "taking summons"; 28 = "Under Attack";
//      26 = "Enemy Approaching"; 19 = "Contact @ Home"; 22 = the summoner's status ("Loading, summon in queue", "Acknowledged", "I'm Dead ... Attach to")
enemySummonBongs=21
homeSummonBongs=27
summonBongs=21
attackBongs=24
underAttackBongs=28
sightedBongs=26,19
chatTeamGap=15            // seconds between two callouts of one team
chatBotGap=40             // seconds between two callouts of one bot
dropship=0                // the CTF:X dropship only knows the MapEnter portals; MiniTP hops are scripted (MiniTP/CTFXMini.cs)
clan=0
milk=0
packs=0
shop=0
mineFriendly=0            // 0: bots lay only enemy-only mines (EMP, grapeshot); 1: also the bullet / plasma / AP mines, which hurt the layer's own team in the blast too
musthave=                 // the seat table (CTFXMini.Roster) always carries SL / Medic / Engineer
focusEnd=none

// ---- movement, doors, shots
routes=1
doors=1
botPlayers=1
nameWrap={}                // bots show as {Name 12}, as in the CTF:X zone (Travis 11-07)
botPlayerIds=low
tdTiers=rookie,regular,veteran,ace   // every tier carries a Teleport Disruptor (CTF:X default: veteran + ace only)
botAntiwarpBots=on        // a Teleport Disruptor holds every enemy bot (spec: bots TD each other)
statsEverySec=30

// ---- smooth movement on the client (Travis 11-07: "laggy and jumpy"): the settings CTF:X runs with. Bots near a human route 10 times a second
updateMs=200              // the engine's own 5 Hz for everyone the nearest-human rule below does not cover
updateNearMs=100          // a bot within nearPx of a human (player or spectator) routes at 10 Hz
nearPx=800                // a screen is ~640 x 480 px plus a margin
nearCap=12                // at most this many bots per human get the fast cadence (CTF:X 6; MiniTP areas are small and full of bots)
farPx=1200
updateFarMs=400           // nobody can see a bot beyond farPx: 2.5 Hz
killCash=250               // Pub: what a human gets for killing a bot (a human kill pays the zone cfg KillReward, 400)
